role: the Regulation as published on 4.5.2016, UNCORRECTED: the corrigendum of 23.5.2018 (the other file in this folder) changes fifteen passages of it. Recital 71 is corrected by the corrigendum; no deposited text carries the corrected recital. The Official Journal text is the authentic one; this file is a rendering of it by a script.
